notes.title: 39,000 Wishlists... and a Development Update 2025/08!!
notes.content: [p]Hey all! Melos from the team here. We made a recent devlog post- if you're interested, just search "Melos Han-Tani Substack" on google and read the latest post![/p][p]But I'll summarize a bit here.[/p][p]So, we are on good progress for releasing this year - likely still November or December![/p][p]We may only be releasing in English first with a localized version coming in following months, although at a minimum we are trying to have Simplified Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese available at launch. Our remaining target languages (Russian, Japanese, Korean, Spanish) will be done if we make enough money.[/p][p]One big milestone for us is finishing the overworlds. Angeline Era has a lot of levels - between 8-20 hours for a single playthrough depending how thorough you are. Here's a preview of one of the first overworld areas:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231730/37a2d1d1c932a301f54ba481bf9ddda6ca3c5d2f.png"][/img][/p][p]Outside of that, I finished the music, a bunch of SFX, and some test playthroughs of the game for design/bugtesting/narrative reasons. Marina on the art side has finished a bunch of new area, NPC, and enemy art, as well as some final writing for the game. We're hoping the game has a unique approach to story and lore! You can enjoy the main storyline, or explore all the areas and imagine for yourself what the backstories to the world are.[/p][p]Other than that, we hit 39,000 total wishlists! Honestly I couldn't ask for much more. I'm just hoping we can have a smooth rest of development for now as I go into some closed Beta testing.[/p][p]Please look forward to Angeline Era later this year! We'll also be keeping the demo up through release - which will retain its multiple translations.[/p][p]Anyways, if you'd like to support us till release, consider sharing a trailer with your friend groups.[/p][list][*][p]Melos[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Trailer for Angeline Era!
notes.content:
Hello, co-developer Melos here! Today, we've released a 2nd trailer, in conjunction with the Game Devs of Color Expo that starts today! Do [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gdocexpo]check it out[/url] if you're curious to see some great games made by primarily POC-led teams!

Here's the trailer:

[previewyoutube=_15akBJq6rU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Other than that, we've broken 6,000 wishlists! So far this is our strongest pre-launch wishlisting campaign yet, so hopefully we can sell enough to remain afloat... ha ha ha! We were also featured in the EEK3 2023 Showcase - a spooky and horror-themed indie game showcase, featuring some of our friends' games as well.

So, what's new in Angeline Era? This summer has been full of level design for me, personally. I've written a song here or there, but primarily I've been getting into a groove and really nailing down the levels - and I'm really excited about the result. Levels range from 3 to 10 minute experiences, and you can enter them from wherever on the overworld. Some levels are linear and challenging - others are sprawling and goal-less - and some are dungeon-y with tricky navigation. There's all kinds of levels in this game, and I'm excited to share all the humorous and creative ideas we've come up with.

On Marina's end, she made significant progress on the script of the game, as well as progress on finalizing the art style (what we show in the trailer/this store page is a little out of date.) That'll be coming together very quickly soon, so I'm excited to show what's next!

NOW, if you've read this far...

We're still selling t-shirts and other game related merch at our store! Check it out here: https://analgesicproductions.bigcartel.com/

Other game updates include:

- A 60 FPS / QOL-update remaster is planned for Anodyne 1 - likely dropping on PC next month, and consoles next year
- Our 2016 platformer Even the Ocean was open sourced!
- The Anodyne 2 physicals will be shipping out soon - with extras available to buy on Amazon later this year!
- ... more planned!

If you'd like to stay up to date on news, follow me on Twitter
https://twitter.com/han_tani

or subscribe to my newsletter! https://melodicambient.substack.com/
